Automation: Rules reference · play automation in progress

You curl your fingers toward the incoming fire and fold its hottest tongue into your palm.

Rules

Action
Reaction
Attribute
None — no roll
Target / range / shape
Self, before taking fire damage from one event.
Duration
Instant.
Equipment / acquisition
None.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Magic / Defense

Gain fire resistance 2 for that event. Use the highest matching resistance, not their sum; the normal minimum damage remains. This does not remove Burning.
